articles.summary: eFax is heading to the Windy City for the 2026 MUSE Inspire Conference, the premier gathering for MEDITECH users, taking place May 19-22. We understand the specific needs of the MEDITECH community, and we’re ready to showcase how eFax integrates seamlessly to transform unstructured data into actionable clinical insights. Stop by Booth #313 at the Hyatt Regency Chicago to see our AI-native data transformation tools in action. We’ll show you how to automate your inbound document workflows, ensure 100% HIPAA compliance, and enhance your MEDITECH ecosystem with secure, digital faxing that simplifies interoperability for hospitals of all sizes. articles.summary: eFax is looking forward to the HIMSS CNFL Impact Hit 2026 Regional Conference in Orlando, where the brightest minds in Florida’s healthcare IT sector gather. This year’s theme, "Race to Innovate: Re‑imagine → Transform → Scale," perfectly captures the urgency of today’s healthcare landscape. As Florida’s top health IT minds gather to accelerate digital delivery, eFax is proud to showcase how we’re helping organizations cross the finish line of digital transformation. Visit the eFax team to see how we help you re-imagine legacy communication, transform unstructured "dark data" into actionable clinical insights, and scale secure interoperability across your entire network. We’ll be demonstrating how our AI-powered, cloud-based data transformation solutions ensure iron-clad HIPAA compliance while eliminating the administrative bottlenecks that slow down patient care. Join us in Orlando to explore actionable strategies for leveraging compliant cloud fax to drive operational excellence and high-speed innovation throughout Central and North Florida. Book a Meeting
